name: roadcraft-workflow
description: Repository-local RoadCraft workflow instructions for source identity, package verification, evidence review and exact-file storage checks, and for authoring vehicle mods with the vehicle-authoring library.

interface.shortDescription: Verify RoadCraft sources, packages and evidence; author vehicle mods.
interface.longDescription: Workflow instructions for an existing RoadCraftToolchain checkout, including the vehicle-authoring library in its library/ folder. This skills-only scaffold does not install or configure an MCP server, Blender, Painter or the native editor.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the RoadCraft workflow to inspect this project's current identities and report verified results and unresolved acceptance work.
